_about: J. L. Myres (Sir John Linton Myres, 1869-1954), Wykeham Professor of Ancient History at Oxford. Classical scholarship, Greek history and Cypriote archaeology (lane B). Raw IA OCR: A Catalogue of the Cyprus Museum (with M. Ohnefalsch-Richter, Oxford, 1899), Greek Lands and the Greek People (inaugural lecture, 1910), The Value of Ancient History (1910), The Dawn of History (Home University Library, 1911), Herodotus, outline analysis of books I-VI (1912), Handbook of the Cesnola Collection of Antiquities from Cyprus (Metropolitan Museum, 1914), The Influence of Anthropology on the Course of Political Science (University of California, 1916) and The Political Ideas of the Greeks (Abingdon Press, 1927). His lecture in Anthropology and the Classics is on the r-r-marett shelf (PG 53646). Not taken: Who Were the Greeks? (1930) not found in a 1930 printing. US public domain. No uids minted.
